ExecPlus Workspace Select dependency notices

The unmodified @radix-ui/react-select 2.3.8 package supplies accessible selection,
keyboard/typeahead, focus management and viewport positioning. ExecPlus supplies
the controlled React wrapper, teal/navy styling and two original decorative SVGs.
No external icon package is included. All new packages are MIT; the pre-existing
tslib 2.8.1 helper is BSD-0-Clause and its full notices are retained here.

Full license text is copied without edits. Exact resolved package integrity,
source repositories and each notice SHA-256 are recorded in inventory.json.

react-remove-scroll-bar 2.3.8 omits a LICENSE file from its npm archive but declares
MIT in package metadata and README. Its license was obtained from the official
repository at commit 8ca9ba5ea52de03308fe8ced94f7b159a44d28ff:
https://github.com/theKashey/react-remove-scroll-bar/blob/8ca9ba5ea52de03308fe8ced94f7b159a44d28ff/LICENSE
The npm gitHead b3b1287aad81def2e2ae707274b74531b61ddbaf was unavailable (HTTP404).
